quote: We propose 'Taxonomy Free Character Role Labeling' (TF-CRL): an open-ended narrative understanding task that assigns a short noun phrase to the function a character performs in a narrative.

We define the task of Taxonomy-Free Character Role Labeling (TF-CRL) as: generating a role label for a given character based on their narrative function as they are depicted by the author in the text.
We formulate our task as producing a machine-generated character role label.
outputs: short noun‑phrase role labels (primary label with optional modifier)
character role labels consisting of a primary label and an optional modifier
